annotation.bound_parties_text: Organisations wanting to deploy an automated passenger service need consent from local licensing authorities or bus franchising bodies, and traffic authorities must be consulted.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Organisations that want to deploy an automated passenger service require consent from the appropriate local taxi and private hire vehicle licensing authority or bus franchising body
